scene: The flamingo clicks happily, projecting transit paths across the city skyline.
picture: A flat side view of the breezy rooftop edge. On the far left, a docked light-rail pod sits with its hatch open. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in a mint hoodie and dance bag stands before the glowing pink mechanical flamingo, which beams light forward. At centre starts a luminous moving walkway. On the far right, a hover ferry bobs beside a gate.
shown: a sleek spherical light-rail pod docked at an elevated rail on the left
a glowing yellow moving walkway glowing at centre with rubber handrails running eastward
a floating river hover ferry moored beside the far right sky-dock gate
